notes: Partners list empty. All 33 files read in full. Most test gaps in this chunk are already in the known ledger and were not re-reported: acdsl-policy-guard, sync_settings marker, nightly gating, worktree.sh symbolic-ref, sync_skills operator-key merge, .serena husk, remote-FROM squash, nested .DS_Store, squashed:2 count, bootstrap roster and non-dry paths, steady-state vacuity, the skill-invoke-gate string-content branch, and the sync_hooks EOF guard. Cross-chunk suspicion for the station (correctness, not tests): at HEAD, skill-invoke-gate.sh denies every non-Skill call before invocation, including a Read of a ~/.claude/context-required/<sid>/*.md file. read-gate.sh (main session, no agent_id) denies every tool, Skill included, until those files are read. A root (non-subagent) session whose first message carries REQUIRE-SKILL without a leading /<skill> would therefore deadlock. Headless lanes start with the slash and subagents owe only invoked-skill spills, so the case looks unreachable today. The deployed hook in this session allowed a pre-invocation Read of global.md, which suggests the deployed copy differs from HEAD.

findings.fix: Make the truncation case keep the valid key line and drop the rest (e.g. head -2 "$cache_file" > "$cache_file.t" && mv "$cache_file.t" "$cache_file"), so only the 5-line completeness check can force the miss.
findings.claim: The 'truncated cache file is a miss' case in test_verdict_cache_hit_and_invalidation overwrites the cache row with the single line 'garbage', which already fails the key comparison at print_agent_worktrees_status.sh:269. The completeness guard [ "$(wc -l < "$cache_file")" -eq 5 ] at line 270, the guard the script comment says protects the read chain from a truncated file, therefore never decides the outcome: delete it and the test stays green. A row file holding the correct key line but fewer than 5 lines would then be served, and the read chain at 271-272 hits EOF.
findings.evidence: Re-read print_agent_worktrees_status.sh 258-282 (the cache_key line, the three-clause hit condition, the read chain) and test lines 605-609. The only truncation fixture is printf 'garbage\n' > "$cache_file". Its first line is not $cache_key, so clause 2 of the hit condition fails before clause 3 runs. No other case writes a short file that starts with the valid key. Removing clause 3 leaves every assertion at 607-609 unchanged.

findings.fix: Extend test_verdict_cache_hit_and_invalidation, or the origin/main fixture, to warm the cache, move refs/remotes/origin/main with update-ref, and assert that the next WORKTREE_STATUS_TRACE=1 run probes again or that IN/UNPICKED change.
findings.claim: The verdict cache key includes $from_tip because WTS_CANDIDATES_DIGEST (line 318) hashes only refs/heads/, so for a remote-tracking FROM (origin/main) from_tip is the only key part that sees FROM move. No test moves a remote FROM after a cached run. Dropping $from_tip from the key keeps the suite green, while after a git fetch moves origin/main the overview would serve stale UNPICKED/VERDICTS/IN/MERGED for every origin-based branch.
findings.evidence: Re-read print_agent_worktrees_status.sh 261-266 and 315-320: the digest uses for-each-ref refs/heads/ only. The test suite's only remote-FROM fixture is test_from_resolves_remote_tracking_origin (update-ref once at line 37, then a single run). test_parallel_output_matches_serial and test_branch_name_selector reuse that repo without moving origin/main. The cache test (568-627) uses a local main FROM, where the candidate digest already invalidates.
